subject: Re: Status: static-analysis repro done, new-task port slower than hoped
body:
Team,

Decisions ahead of the review. Project Quillon goes to the Launch Review Board on 6/11 - Nadia has us on the agenda.

1. Demo scope: static-analysis task plus the retrieval task capped at 20k nodes, per Fumiko's proposal. Sharding is explicitly out of scope for this window; I have written it into the Q3 candidate list.
2. The Python 3.6 toolchain lift Bilal did stays internal-only for now; we will not advertise the modernized package until it has soaked for a month.
3. Halima's eval harness is the sign-off gate: I want the automaton-policy accuracy table and memory ceiling documented in the pre-read, not spoken to.

If 5/20's trainable version regresses this week, tell me by Friday and we present static analysis alone. Rather cut than slip.

Anders
